knowledge_graph.title: Lovelace Women's Hospital- Breast Care Center
knowledge_graph.type: Medical clinic in Albuquerque, New Mexico
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "The Lovelace Women's Hospital- Breast Care Center is a clinic located in Albuquerque, New Mexico. This facility specializes in providing comprehensive breast care services to patients. While it is not an urgent care, quick care, or emergency facility, it is dedicated to offering high-quality care specifically tailored to women's breast health needs. Whether you require routine screenings or more advanced diagnostic procedures, the Breast Care Center at Lovelace Women's Hospital is equipped to provide the necessary care and support."
